field_mappings.transformation: Trim surrounding whitespace, remove spaces and other ABN separators from the native abn value, then validate the 11-digit ABN checksum; reject values that fail validation and do not infer an identifier from digit length alone.

unmapped_fields.reason: Generic counterparty name in a contracts register; the header does not establish the registered legal name, and values can embed trading-name wording such as 't/a', so no entity.legal_name mapping is supported.
